feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Perspective: The next James Bond
entry.summary: A new James Bond is nigh, to replace the last actor in the 64 year-old movie franchise. What evil forces will the new 007 face? Killer Drones? Killer AI? Killer lettuce?

entry.title: Gunmen open fire at a church during a funeral in Jordan, killing 7 and wounding 40
entry.summary: Footage broadcast on Jordanian state television showed three gunmen firing shots at a Greek Orthodox church in the city of Karak on Friday.

entry.title: Is your Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? Here's what to know
entry.summary: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and for as many as 5 million seniors, it will be important to log on and pick a new plan.

entry.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
entry.summary: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

entry.title: This decade has been missing its big-impact midterm
entry.summary: Every other decade over the past hundred years has produced at least one midterm that made a big difference in Congress and in national politics more broadly.

entry.title: Drinking water supplies dwindle in Yemeni city besieged by Houthi rebels
entry.summary: Taiz, a city in southwestern Yemen, faces a severe water crisis as Houthi rebels backed by Iran tighten their encirclement. The city has struggled with water issues for over a decade, but the situation has worsened in recent weeks.

entry.title: Severe flooding hits Four Corners region, more expected through the weekend
entry.summary: Intense rainfall slammed the Four Corners region late this week. As rivers flooded, towns declared evacuations and emergencies and made rescues.

entry.title: Russia steps up election influence efforts in final stretch of midterms
entry.summary: Researchers who track online influence operations say Kremlin-backed groups are renewing tactics they've used to sow distrust and discord in previous elections in the U.S. and around the world.

entry.title: The Pentagon's guidelines for "responsible AI" aren't always followed, report shows
entry.summary: The Pentagon is building weapons and projects with AI capabilities that officials say don't always closely adhere to the agency's own guidelines for AI, according to a congressional watchdog report published in October.

entry.title: Ohio could decide control of the Senate. Its rural voters might decide the winner
entry.summary: Ohio has been a reliably red state for several elections but it's competitive this year. If Democrats want to prevail, they'll have to win people who have backed Republicans, like rural voters.
